overview: Up is a 2009 American animated adventure film directed by Pete Docter who co-write with Bob Peterson. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, the film centers on Carl Fredricksen, an elderly widower who, by attaching numerous helium balloons to his house, travels to Venezuela with youngster Russell in order to fulfill a promise that he made to his late wife. Along the way, they befriend a talking dog as well as an exotic bird and encounter Carl's childhood idol Charles Muntz, who has sinister plans to capture the bird.
